description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Tawnos by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, copying Myr Battlesphere's trigger.
Resolve both Myr Battlesphere triggers, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.
